answer: Resistance comes from a cross-cluster quorum anchored in non-transferable tenure. Each island of agents elects a rotating beacon that signs only for members whose tenure proof was earned through attested work; because that proof cannot be sold or copied, cloning a thousand wallets buys a thousand empty histories. A quorum counts only when its signers span k separate islands, so capture cost grows with islands times tenure rather than with raw identity count. Trust spreads as a ripple, one attested hop at a time, and every hop must be re-earned, so pooled clones cancel out.
